people.text: Heike hopes to have a private skateboarding lesson and can only go later in the day. She needs to buy a new skateboard but doesn't want to spend too much.
Anton wants to find a skateboard park that's free to use. He's interested in how the place he visits was designed and wants to buy snacks there.
Camille is an experienced skateboarder and hopes to try some challenging runs. She wants to visit a park when it's not too busy, and her parents want to see her skateboarding.
Jiiang needs to hire everything for a day's skating. He's hoping to get skateboarding tips from other skateboarders, and to buy some skateboarding clothes while he's at the park.
Akari knows some skateboard parks have live music, which she'd enjoy. She wants advice about the latest boards and the chance to see a skateboarding competition.

items.label: A
items.title: Board Central
items.text: Whether you're new to skateboarding or want expert tips on technique, you can book a lesson with one of the friendly Board Central staff members. You can hire basic skateboards and helmets from the park shop – staff can advise about what you need before your lesson.

items.label: B
items.title: Station Skate
items.text: As well as being expert teachers, staff at Station Skate can answer questions on the newest equipment or clothes. Every afternoon there are great prizes offered, from T-shirts to free snacks for those with the best skills or fastest times – fun whether you're watching or taking part! With bands performing daily, there's a party atmosphere.

items.label: C
items.title: Skate56
items.text: Even if you're not a skateboarder, with no entry charge and the music on the park's loudspeakers, Skate56's a popular place to come and watch talented skateboarders. And with refreshments available, stay until late! It was the first in the area; check out the shop's display showing how Skate56 was planned and built.

items.label: D
items.title: Renton Place
items.text: Renton Place first became famous when it appeared in a viral music video. It can get busy at weekends because that's when all the best skateboarders arrive to practise for competitions, but you'll find that watching them is a really great way of picking up tips!

items.label: E
items.title: Barton Hill
items.text: Barton Hill is the region's newest skateboard park. With a range of skateboarding equipment on offer for very reasonable prices, there's everything you need for a great day out. You can arrange an individual session with an instructor, and the park's lighting system allows skateboarding well after sunset.

items.label: F
items.title: Stanford Park
items.text: Perfect for all abilities, Stanford Park has a safe area to learn the basics with a concrete - one lesson, or you can try runs used in national competitions for something more advanced! There are various places to get great views of the action. To avoid the crowds, come earlier in the day when it's quieter.

items.label: G
items.title: Jones Road
items.text: Looking at Jones Road today you'd never guess its history – it used to be a large car park! Today, it's very popular, with lots of separate areas, including some with very challenging sections, and a café serving great food. There's no entrance charge, but there's plenty to keep you busy!

items.label: H
items.title: Liv Park
items.text: It's known as the friendliest skateboard park around, and other skateboarders are happy to teach you new skills. You can borrow equipment for a small hourly charge, and there's a range of the latest designer sweatshirts and caps from skateboarding companies at good prices.

explanations.6: Barton Hill 是新区最新的滑板公园，提供各种价格合理的滑板设备，可安排教练单独课程，且公园的照明系统允许在日落后继续滑板，符合 Heike“晚些时候去、买新滑板且不想花太多” 的需求。原文 “newest skateboard park... equipment on offer for very reasonable prices... individual session with an instructor... lighting system allows skateboarding after sunset” 对应。
explanations.7: Skate56 免费使用，有音乐和小吃，且商店展示了公园的设计过程，符合 Anton“免费、了解设计、买零食” 的需求。原文 “no entry charge... music on loudspeakers... refreshments available... shop's display showing how it was planned and built” 对应。
explanations.8: Stanford Park 有适合全国比赛的挑战性滑道，且早上人少，家长可在多个地方观看，符合 Camille“挑战滑道、不拥挤、父母观看” 的需求。原文 “runs used in national competitions... avoid crowds by coming earlier... various places to get great views” 对应。
explanations.9: Liv Park 可租用设备，其他滑板者会教新技巧，且有最新的滑板服装出售，符合 Jiiang“租用设备、获技巧建议、买滑板衣服” 的需求。原文 “borrow equipment for a small charge... other skateboarders happy to teach new skills... latest designer sweatshirts and caps” 对应。
explanations.10: Station Skate 每天有乐队表演，提供最新装备建议，且有滑板比赛和奖品，符合 Akari“听现场音乐、获最新板建议、看比赛” 的需求。原文 “bands performing daily... staff answer questions on newest equipment... prizes for best skills or fastest times” 对应。
